visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Every function returns 3
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The three functions were meant to return 0, 10 and 20, but all three return 30. The loop variable is shared by all the functions.

solution.explanation: var has one variable for the whole function, so by the time the functions run the loop has ended and n is 3. let makes a new variable for each pass, and every function keeps its own.
